Sort by businesses you are member of.

- `created_at`: when the business was made.
- `title`: title of business.
- `total_app_members`: total ambassadors in business.

Note that when not sorting by created_at, desc(created_at) is used as tiebreaker.

items.title: BusinessMemberRole
items.description:
Role of a BusinessMember.

`owner`: Has complete read and write access to the business.
Can delete the business.

`admin`: Has the same access as the owner, except they cannot delete the business,
change the owner or promote other users to admin.

`billing`: Has read access to the business and can manage billing.

`collaborator`: Has the same access as the admin, except they cannot edit the
business or view billing.

`moderator`: Has the same access as the collaborator, except they cannot manage
treets.

`viewer`: Has read access to the business.

The tree lookup is as follows:
owner
  |
  │
admin
  ├──────────────┐
  │              │
collaborator  billing
  │
  │
moderator
  │
  │
viewer
